pose: Full profile view, head of the hammer at the top
visual_description: A professional-grade geological rock pick. The head is a single piece of drop-forged steel. One side of the head is a flat, square striking face; the opposite side is a long, sharp, slightly curved pointed pick (not a claw). The handle is a high-visibility blue or black shock-reduction vinyl grip. The steel has a satin finish with high-fidelity specular highlights.

constraints.anatomy_fix: Strictly no curved nail-pulling claw; replace with a solid tapered geological pick point.
constraints.background: Solid neutral 50% grey floor plane with soft-edged contact shadows.
